_readme: Fill in ref_url for each program after you are accepted. Until a program has a
real ref_url, the site links to the provider's normal pricing page with no tracking
and shows no 'referral' badge. Never paste a guessed or placeholder code here:
qa_check.py fails the build if a placeholder code is present.
commission_note is free text shown only in MONETIZATION docs, not on the site.

programs.name: DigitalOcean
programs.commission_note: Public referral program (credit for referrer once the referred account spends a threshold). Confirm current terms in your Referral dashboard.
programs.notes: Approval is usually instant through the DigitalOcean referral dashboard.

programs.name: Vultr
programs.commission_note: Referral credit program. Confirm current terms in your account.

programs.name: Hetzner Cloud
programs.commission_note: Hetzner does not run a general public affiliate program; link normally.
programs.notes: Keep as a plain editorial link to stay credible on price.

programs.name: Akamai / Linode
programs.commission_note: Check whether the current Akamai referral or partner program accepts self-serve publishers.

programs.name: Scaleway
programs.commission_note: Referral credit exists in some regions; confirm eligibility.

programs.name: Cloudways
programs.commission_note: Managed hosting affiliate program with published per-sale payouts. Confirm current tiers in the affiliate dashboard.
programs.notes: Good fit for the managed-hosting alternative section.

programs.name: Hostinger (VPS)
programs.commission_note: High per-sale affiliate tiers for VPS and hosting. Confirm current tiers in the affiliate dashboard.

programs.name: RunPod
programs.commission_note: GPU cloud referral program; confirm publisher eligibility.
programs.notes: Use for the GPU-instance alternative section.
